title: renderReadinessPanel wraps the PO layer around the engineer body and picks the register from profile.md
description: `renderReadinessPanel(result, { profileText })` picks the register from `profile.md` (productOwner | engineer | unstated), renders the engineer body (the pre-PR-8 Readiness rendering: tree line, CLI verdict lines, next-action-per-persona, D1..D8 chips, PO + Engineer blocker groups, delta/diff) once, and hands it to `renderReadinessPO` as `engineerBody`. The engineer body is never removed from the DOM; `renderReadinessPO` is what folds it into the For-engineers DocRow and decides open/closed per register (AC-18002-3).
